newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - P&G FY97 estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - P&G FY97 estimates raised.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Michael Grant said he increased the fiscal year 1997 and fiscal year 1998 earnings estimates for Procter & Gamble Co.
-- said raised FY97 estimate to $4.86 per share from $4.83 per share and raised FY98 estimate to $5.50 per share from $5.45 per share.
-- said maintained buy rating on the stock.
-- lowered sales growth estimate to a range of 2.5 pct to three percent for full-year 1997.

-- "We look for accelerating operating momentum (as measured by sales and EPS growth) through calendar year 1997. We see no significant red flags (except continued dollar strength) in P&G's immediate-term outlook," Grant said.
-- P&G shares were off 1/2 at 110-1/4 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
